prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delay Sign-In After Pet Creation: Move the sign-in step to after adoption certificate creation so users form an emotional attachment to their pet before signing up.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selection Stage: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual stage layout with interactive pet choice cards and personality badges.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "label": "Pick Pet"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Guide: Insert a new onboarding screen before home intro showing users key desktop shortcuts to summon, hide, and talk to their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"], "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "How to Interact With Your Pet", "body": "Learn quick hotkeys and mouse actions to hide, move, or talk to your pet on your desktop.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Pet Quick-Start Sub-Flow: Replace photo upload with instant pre-generated pet personality templates to prevent creation failures.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"replace": {"photo_upload": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "photo_upload", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose", "label": "Select Starter Preset"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Restores & Sync Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users how to log back into existing accounts to preserve saved pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original account method to keep your existing pets and progress intact."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Status & Diagnostics: Show progress and desktop rendering status updates on the waiting screen so users know their pet is initializing.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Summoning your pet to desktop...", "body": "Rendering pet graphics and configuring desktop overlay permissions.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Onboarding Roadmap Checklist: Change choose_path layout to a checklist displaying the step counter and progress track.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "checklist", "show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Quick Controls Tip Carousel: Add a tip carousel to the home intro screen providing actionable tips on controlling desktop pet behaviors.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to access commands, hide, or settings.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "plain", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Add a celebratory official companion badge and preview component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "label": "Certified Companion Owner"}, {"type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
9: [sign_in, notification] Account Privacy & Deletion Notice: Include a body notice on the sign-in screen reassuring users about data privacy and easy account deletion options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Your privacy matters. Account data is securely encrypted, and you can export or delete your data at any time from settings."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet adoption is explicitly allowed inside onboarding.
Redesigning the pet selection screen is allowed as long as it still lets the user choose a pet.
Adding a new interactive guide screen before home intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Replacing photo upload removes the core job of allowing users to upload photos to make their own pet.
Adding sign-in hints regarding existing accounts is allowed.
Adding progress updates and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning choose_path layout with progress tracking is allowed.
Adding interactive tips to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Replaces or omits the required official stamp on the adoption certificate.
Adding privacy and data management notices to the sign-in screen is compliant with fair design rules.
